payload.title: Sensitivity to resolution
payload.description: This workflow examines the sensitivity of the LERM model to changes in resolution by recreating Figure 4 from the original publication. It involves data processing, analysis, and visualization using various Python libraries.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries for data processing and visualization. Suppress warnings for presentation purposes.
steps.title: Import Libraries and Suppress Warnings

steps.description: Define group lists for easy loading and process ODP 925 data by reading and formatting the time and d18O values.
steps.title: Load and Process ODP 925 Data

steps.description: Load stable series data, bin it, and prepare it for analysis.
steps.title: Process Stable Series Data

steps.description: Artificially coarsen the stable synthetic data by removing a percentage of values between specified bounds.
steps.title: Artificial Data Coarsening

steps.description: Set up the production figure with specified font sizes and generate the comprehensive figure illustrating sensitivity to resolution changes.
steps.title: Generate Full Figure
